title: Variance-Based Rewards for Approximate Bayesian Reinforcement Learning
review_status: full-text audit complete; Bayesian variance bonus theory and controlled exploration results reviewed
sections_checked: Bayesian reward bonus derivation and assumptions
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2012-03-15; exact v1 PDF audited
evidence_note: Structured-prior Wumpus result reports mean reward 0.508 over 500 episodes versus 0.266 mean-MDP and 0.183 BOSS; theorem depends on specified prior/model, and advantage is not broad real-world validation.

title: Identifying reasoning patterns in games
review_status: full-text audit complete; MAID graph algorithm and scope of evidence reviewed
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2012-06-13; exact v1 PDF audited
evidence_note: Identifies four graphical reasoning patterns and may remove irrelevant decision nodes; exponential savings are a potential structural result, not measured runtime, and parameter-aware analysis remains open.

title: Simple Regret Optimization in Online Planning for Markov Decision Processes
review_status: full-text audit complete; BRUE guarantees and empirical evaluation conditions reviewed
sections_checked: finite-MDP assumptions and convergence transition period
venue_year_verified: arXiv v2 dated 2012-12-19; exact v2 HTML audited
evidence_note: Proves exponential-rate simple-regret/action-error reduction under finite-MDP assumptions and tests controlled sailing grids/random trees; the asymptotic guarantee is not a fixed-budget or real-world transfer claim.

title: Goal Inference Improves Objective and Perceived Performance in Human-Robot Collaboration
review_status: full-text audit complete; behavioral experiment outcomes and task-allocation counterevidence reviewed
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2018-02-06; exact v1 PDF audited; journal reference AAMAS 2016
evidence_note: Virtual study retained 196 of 234 recruits; adaptive behavior improved time/preference, but Bayesian robot completed 1.7 more tasks than oracle in a small 39-task comparison; avatar trajectory was scripted.

title: Toward a Computational Theory of Evidence-Based Reasoning for Instructable Cognitive Agents
review_status: full-text audit complete; framework, four prototypes, and absence of comparative metrics reviewed
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2019-10-09; exact v1 PDF audited
evidence_note: Describes four public-sector prototypes but reports no comparative accuracy, time, calibration, or error-reduction outcomes; architecture evidence should not be represented as effectiveness evidence.

title: Learning Deductive Reasoning from Synthetic Corpus based on Formal Logic
review_status: full-text audit complete; answer/proof distinction, cross-corpus results, and transfer caveats reviewed
venue_year_verified: arXiv v3 dated 2023-11-14; exact v3 HTML audited; ICML/PMLR 2023
evidence_note: GPT-4 answer/proof accuracy differs 52.4/12.8 on FLD and 49.4/3.2 on FLD-star; EntailmentBank provides transfer evidence but requires full target training and does not establish general reasoning.

title: Towards Robust Multi-Modal Reasoning via Model Selection
review_status: full-text audit complete; model-selection benchmark, filtering, and oracle gap reviewed
venue_year_verified: arXiv v2 dated 2024-03-23; exact v2 HTML audited
evidence_note: From 10,000 MS-GQA candidates, invalid generated computation graphs were filtered, leaving 8,426; five-seed selector success is about 69% versus 56% random and 100% oracle, so this is conditional on task decomposition and one benchmark.

title: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Without Prompting
review_status: full-text audit complete; alternative-token decoding gains, inference costs, and reasoning errors reviewed
venue_year_verified: arXiv v2 dated 2024-05-23; exact v2 PDF audited
evidence_note: Mistral-7B GSM8K accuracy is reported as 25.1% versus 9.9% greedy, with gains varying by task; alternative-path search costs extra inference and does not verify chain faithfulness.

title: RegexPSPACE: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Reasoning on PSPACE-complete Regex Problems
review_status: full-text audit complete; formal benchmark metrics, model failure patterns, and construction limits reviewed
sections_checked: main model tables and metric definitions
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2025-10-10; exact v1 HTML audited
evidence_note: GPT-OSS-low reports 84.45% equivalence, 67.36% minimality, and 78.48% output-length ratio versus a 72.70% theoretical best ratio; benchmark scope is constrained by double-exponential labeling cost.

title: A Survey of Secure Retrieval-Augmented Generation
review_status: full-text audit complete; survey search, evaluation map, counterexamples, and snapshot limitations reviewed
venue_year_verified: arXiv v4 dated 2026-10-07; exact v4 HTML audited; stated review snapshot through 2026-04-30
evidence_note: Survey curates 135 works; among 15 evaluation-primary works it maps 14 mainly to fixed-instance targets and one to cross-query targets. It recognizes multi-surface studies and proposes integration rather than claiming none exist.

title: MedRouter: Demystifying Knowledge Differences Across Medical LLMs for Routing-Based Reasoning
review_status: full-text audit complete; benchmark comparisons, judge dependency, OOD scope, and clinical boundary reviewed
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2026-09-27; exact v1 HTML audited
evidence_note: Reports 45.9/46.1% mean accuracy versus 42.6% strongest router and 64.3% per-question oracle on 19,034 test questions, evaluated by GPT-5.6-luna; this is QA benchmark evidence, not clinical validation.
